text:
Lena (Product Designer): dropping a quick proposal for a compact 'triage lanes' layout. goals: super tight rows, an inline diff peek (± icon) that expands without navigating away, and a bulk-move modal that can surface the top failing example. figma: https://redwood.mock/f/approve-lanes-v1
Gabe (PM): love the inline peek. question: do we auto-mark runs as viewed when peeking? want to avoid accidental state changes during quick scans.
Lena (Product Designer): proposal: only mark viewed on explicit action (click 'Mark viewed') or when user tabs out of expanded pane. show a subtle viewed dot otherwise.
Marta (Frontend Eng): implementation constraints: lazy-mount diff renderer on first expand to keep initial load light. bulk-move should stream progress per-run instead of blocking. for selections across pages, chunking required to avoid timeouts.
Theo (Accessibility): a11y checklist: expand control must have aria-expanded and aria-controls; expanded diff should use aria-live=polite when content appears; if we auto-mark viewed, announce 'Run X marked viewed'. +/- icon contrast needs improvement at small sizes.
Ravi (Research): from sessions, reviewers want a 1-line summary above the diff and a one-click 'copy failing example'. they also want quick reasons in the bulk modal: dropdown options (flaky, spam, low-quality, needs-edit).
Gabe (PM): product decision: default reason when none chosen? and undo window. suggest default to 'needs-followup' and provide undo for 24 hours with visible activity log and snackbar.
Lena (Product Designer): CTA copy choices for modal primary: 'Move runs', 'Move to Follow-up', 'Confirm move'. prefer 'Move to Follow-up'. secondary: 'Add note'.
Marta (Frontend Eng): API suggestion: POST /runs/bulk_move -> returns job_id; GET /runs/bulk_move/{job_id}/events streams events like 'moved:run-id' / 'failed:run-id'. frontend shows per-row spinner until event.
Theo (Accessibility): snackbar must be role=alert and keyboard reachable; when undo completes focus should return to the run row that was the user's context. confirmation modals need aria-modal and focus trap.
Ravi (Research): we'll run a small A/B: hypothesis inline diff peek reduces context-switches by >30%. telemetry: expands, copies, moves-from-expanded.
Gabe (PM): retention/legal: override reasons persist for 90 days. tag eng-security after sync. for very large bulk (e.g., 200 runs) show a confirmation: 'You're about to move 200 runs to Follow-up. This may take a few minutes. Continue?' and estimate time.
Lena (Product Designer): accessibility microcopy: expand button label 'Show diff for run {id}', tooltip 'Open inline regression diff'. make icons focusable and give visible focus rings.
Marta (Frontend Eng): edge-case: bulk move across pages — modal confirms selection count and we chunk moves. optimistic UI: render temporary progress rows and show final snackbar after all events.
Theo (Accessibility): also add landmarks for lane headers so SR users can jump between lanes quickly. ensure tooltips are reachable via keyboard (use aria-describedby).
Lena (Product Designer): ok I'll update the mock with: (1) lazy-mount inline diff (2) one-click copy example button (3) bulk modal with collapsed example preview and reason dropdown (4) undo snackbar with 24h revert and activity log entry.
